svg.title: Fitting a subset and reviewing one gate across the full cell population
svg.desc: Schematic pooled and per-slide vectors define the model-fitting scope. All included finite intensities X supply quantile bounds and the full application population. A stable-ID subset, with a default cap of 200000, supplies the two-component Gaussian or two-component Gamma fit. Follow the fitted model down to higher-mean responsibilities at distinct fitting intensities, then left through increasing score correction to saved intensity-score pairs and their interpolated score. The score cutoff determines the proposed intensity gate before review across all X. A separate path supplies all included intensities to the proposed-gate panel. Its score cutoff, intensity gate and cell counts appear together on the left; review can keep or adjust this gate in the right panel. Both plots preserve the same measurement positions. Brackets show counts below and at or above each gate; equality is positive. Review can keep or change the gate without refitting, then save a shared pooled decision or each per-slide decision. Symbols and gate positions are schematic. The caption explains constant outcomes and Gamma exact-zero handling.
